title: Book Two · Chapter 5: A Small Hole
story:
Leo's shoe has a small hole.

Ronan sees it during the ball game on Friday. A pale sock shows through the dark cloth.

“Your foot is looking out,” he says.

“It likes the weather.”

Leo puts his foot on the ball. It rolls away. Jun runs after it and kicks it between two bags.

“Goal!”

“You moved the bags,” Leo says.

“They moved when you fell on them.”

“I did not fall.”

“You sat down very fast.”

Ronan laughs. Leo runs after the ball. The three of them play until the bell rings.

Back inside, Miss Wu asks everyone to open a story. Leo turns to the right page at once. Ronan takes longer. His paper marker is bent in the middle.

They read the first part together. Leo reads quickly. He stops at one long name, goes back, and tries it again.

Ronan looks at the picture beside the name. There are two boys by a tree.

Miss Wu asks the class a question about the story. Mei answers first. Leo begins to put up his hand, then takes it down.

At break, Ronan asks him about it.

“I thought it was the other boy,” Leo says.

“The one by the tree?”

“Yes. The names look nearly the same.”

Ronan checks the page. One name has an extra little mark.

“I did not see that either.”

They put a finger under each name. Leo reads them again. This time he gives the two boys different voices. One sounds like a very old man.

“He is nine,” Ronan says.

“He has a very old voice.”

Ronan tries the second boy. His voice comes out too high. They close the book before the laugh grows loud.

After school, Leo has to wait for his mother. Ronan waits with him near the gate. They put a little stone between their shoes and try to roll it to each other.

“Are you taking your bike out tomorrow?” Leo asks.

“Dad and I will practise after his work.”

“Can I come?”

“I need to ask. We only chose the time yesterday.”

Leo nods. He looks at the hole in his shoe.

“Mum will make me change these.”

“You could put the other shoe on this foot.”

“Then my other foot would look out.”

His mother comes through the school gate. She sees the shoe at once.

“Ah. Those shoes were by the door this morning. Now I see the hole.”

Leo looks down.

“We will fix it at home,” she says. “Come on.”

Ronan walks back along West Lane. At home, he asks Dad about tomorrow. Dad checks his time and agrees. They will meet after four, at the quiet open space. Leo must bring an adult too.

Mum gives Ronan a little note for Leo's mother. He takes it next door to Mrs Lan first and asks her to check the time with him.

“Four,” she reads.

He points to Dad's words underneath.

“And only if it is dry.”

Mrs Lan nods. Ronan leaves for Leo's home with the note held flat.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

sock＝袜子；extra＝额外的；hole＝洞；underneath＝在下面。

## 理解问题

1. Leo读故事时漏看了什么？
2. 周六一起练车确定了哪些条件？

## 读句子

A pale sock / shows through / the dark cloth.＝浅色袜子／从……露出／深色布料。
